searchText: Hi! Please run the node with the `--enable-debug-rpc-endpoints` flag. Debug namespace is disabled by default I should have a copy of the configs(kurtosis) he used, I can try it out and tell you what it says - worst case I'm sure mario can re-run it once he's up I can confirm it works with this flag, `/eth/v2/debug/beacon/state/xxxx` responds with the state. <@892053833121923094> I had to add `"beacon_extra_params": ["--enable-debug-rpc-endpoints"]` to the kurtosis config and it works after that Hi, can we start spamming blobs on devnet8? It'll be useful to validate some fixes 🙂 we're already spamming blobs 😄 https://blobscan.com/ should be 3 blobs every 10s i think, its in a cronjob and does so forever or is the request to spam more blobs? shoudl be good for me, thanks!
